Job description
We are looking for a skilled AI Engineer with a strong foundation in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and NLP. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in LLM fine-tuning, OCR & Document Understanding, and AI Agent/Multi-Agent systems, with the ability to develop, optimize, and deploy AI models in production. This role focuses on Core AI/ML Engineering, LLM Fine-tuning, and Agentic AI. Candidates are expected to have hands-on model training and fine-tuning experience, rather than solely LLM API integration, prompt engineering, or RAG chatbot development.
• Research, develop, train, fine-tune, and deploy AI/ML models.
• Fine-tune open-source LLMs using LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, and SFT.
• Develop OCR, Document Understanding, and Information Extraction solutions.
• Design and implement AI Agent and Multi-Agent systems for complex workflows.
• Build and optimize model training, evaluation, and inference pipelines.
• Research and implement advanced AI techniques from academic papers.
Your skills and experience
• Education: Bachelor's degree/Master’s degree in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a related field.
• Experience : Minimum 1–2 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML (industry experience)
• Programming : Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, SQL.
• ML Frameworks & Libraries : PyTorch, TensorFlow, NumPy, Pandas.
• AI/Deep Learning : Strong understanding of ML, DL, NLP, and Transformer architectures.
• LLM Fine-tuning : Hands-on experience with LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, and SFT on models such as Qwen, Llama, and Mistral.
• AI Agents & Multi-Agent Systems : LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or equivalent; tool calling, agent orchestration, multi-agent collaboration.
• Document AI : OCR, Document Layout Analysis, and Information Extraction.
• Model Optimization : GPU/CUDA, quantization, hyperparameter tuning, model evaluation.
• Deployment : FastAPI, RESTful APIs, vLLM, or equivalent frameworks.
• Database : PostgreSQL, MySQL.
• DevOps : Docker, Git (version control), Linux, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
• Language: English
Nice to have
• Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, MLOps, and distributed training.
• Experience with Multimodal AI (VLM) and Document AI fine-tuning.
• Experience designing production-grade Agentic AI systems, including RAG, planning, memory, and multi-agent orchestration.
• Publications at CORE Rank A/A* conferences (e.g., ACL, EMNLP, NAACL) are a strong advantage; conference ranks should be checked against the relevant ranking edition.
• Ability to read, reproduce, and implement methods from AI research papers.

• Có kiến thức vững về thiết kế API, giao tiếp giữa các dịch vụ và các giao thức phục vụ realtime/streaming như WebSocket, gRPC streaming hoặc công nghệ tương đương.
• Hiểu và vận dụng được các cơ chế quản lý kết nối, quản lý trạng thái phiên, timeout, cancellation, retry, idempotency và backpressure trong hệ thống bất đồng bộ.

• Có kinh nghiệm dẫn dắt kỹ thuật end-to-end cho một dịch vụ/phân hệ từ phân tích yêu cầu, thiết kế, phát triển, kiểm thử đến triển khai và vận hành.

Job description
• Define and implement quality assurance strategies for AI agents built on our bbv AI Hub product, covering functional correctness, robustness, reliability, safety, and regression behavior.
• Validate complete agent workflows, from user input and tool calls to integrations and final responses.
• Design and maintain versioned, traceable test datasets that turn business requirements and real user scenarios into test cases, including edge cases, multi-step and tool-use tasks, and safety scenarios.
• Use Langfuse to benchmark agent versions, prompts, models, and configurations against standardized datasets, tracking metrics such as task success, tool-call correctness, hallucination rate, latency, and cost.
• Design evaluation rubrics and LLM-as-a-judge prompts, combining deterministic, LLM-based, and human evaluation, and validate the reliability of automated evaluators.
• Establish baselines, quality thresholds, and regression criteria for agent releases, and support automated quality gates in CI/CD pipelines.
• Analyze failed agent traces to find root causes and turn production failures and user feedback into permanent regression test cases.
• Work closely with AI Engineers, Software Engineers, and Product Owners to define measurable acceptance criteria, resolve issues, and verify fixes.
• Report evaluation results clearly and contribute to AI agent quality standards on the bbv AI Hub.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to trace complex failures to their root cause.

Job description
Architecture & Technical Design
• Own end-to-end architecture for the team‘s RAG, Agentic and Multi-Agent systems - retrieval strategy, agent orchestration patterns (Planner–Executor, Router, Verifier, Reviewer), tool-calling layer and state management.
• Make and defend technology choices (vector DB, embedding model, orchestration framework, observability stack) with explicit trade-off analysis on capability, cost, latency and compliance.
• Set engineering standards (coding conventions, inter-agent contracts, MCP tool schemas, minimum observability bar) and write ADRs for high-impact decisions.
• Design reusable components (retrieval templates, MCP server skeletons, guardrail middleware, evaluation harnesses) so engineers don‘t rebuild foundations for each product.
Hands-on Engineering
• Personally write code for the hardest components: agent orchestration core, tool-calling middleware, complex retrieval, guardrail engine and tricky integrations with bank legacy systems.
• Prototype new architectural ideas and own the hard production incidents the team can‘t crack — hallucination edge cases, retrieval regressions, vLLM latency spikes, schema-breaking tool-call failures.
• Stay hands-on: expect 40–50% of your time on direct coding. This is not a technical PM seat.
Mentorship & Code Review
• Run high-quality code reviews that teach failure modes, cost awareness, observability and maintainability — not just check logic.
• Mentor engineers 1-on-1 on technical growth and design decisions.
Stakeholder Representation, R&D and Reliability
• Be the team‘s technical face with Risk, Compliance, IT Infrastructure and Business - translating regulatory and business constraints into design decisions, and technical trade-offs back to stakeholders.
• Drive technical R&D: evaluate emerging techniques, run benchmarks, separate hype from value, and contribute to the division‘s technical roadmap.
• Own production quality KPIs (hallucination rate, retrieval recall@k, tool success rate, latency, uptime); maintain evaluation frameworks that gate deployments; lead incident response and post-mortems.
• Enforce banking-grade non-functional requirements: auditability, explainability and end-to-end traceability for internal audit and legal.

Must-Have
• Bachelor‘s degree or higher in Computer Science, AI, Data Science or a related field.

Bạn sẽ xây dựng các hệ thống AI Agent cho dự án chính phủ và doanh nghiệp lớn, nơi dữ liệu phải ở lại trong hạ tầng của khách hàng. Ưu tiên hàng đầu là triển khai on-premise, kết hợp hybrid với cloud khi dữ liệu và quy định cho phép.
• Thiết kế và phát triển AI Agent cho nghiệp vụ hành chính công: Tự thiết kế kiến trúc agent (single/multi-agent, workflow vs. agent tự trị), code, test và tích hợp các agent xử lý hồ sơ, tra cứu văn bản pháp quy, hỗ trợ soạn thảo và tổng hợp báo cáo.
• Xây tool và MCP server: Thiết kế tool, MCP server kết nối agent với API, database và hệ thống quản lý văn bản; đảm bảo structured output ổn định, xử lý lỗi/retry, phân quyền và các bước human-in-the-loop.
• Sở hữu pipeline RAG: Chịu trách nhiệm chất lượng end-to-end cho tài liệu tiếng Việt (văn bản scan, bảng biểu, công văn): parsing/OCR, chunking, embedding, đánh chỉ mục, hybrid search, re-ranking, trích dẫn nguồn — và chứng minh cải tiến bằng số liệu eval.
• Triển khai mô hình on-premise: Trực tiếp triển khai các mô hình open-weight thế hệ mới (DeepSeek V4.1, Qwen3.8, GLM-5.3, gpt-oss…) trên hạ tầng GPU của khách hàng, kể cả môi trường mạng nội bộ hoặc air-gapped.
• Serving và hạ tầng inference: Vận hành và tối ưu inference engine (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) và lớp điều phối (NVIDIA Dynamo, llm-d) trên Kubernetes; tối ưu KV cache, routing, lượng tử hóa (FP8, FP4); benchmark throughput/latency và sizing GPU cho từng dự án.
• Kiến trúc hybrid: Xây model gateway định tuyến giữa mô hình on-premise và cloud theo mức độ nhạy cảm dữ liệu, chi phí và độ trễ.
• Evals và an toàn: Xây bộ dữ liệu test, thiết lập eval tự động trong CI, đo độ chính xác và hallucination; triển khai guardrails, lọc dữ liệu cá nhân, audit log theo yêu cầu an toàn thông tin.
• Vận hành production: Thiết lập observability (log, trace, latency, chi phí token); xử lý sự cố, viết postmortem; tối ưu prompt và context dựa trên dữ liệu thực tế.
• Dẫn dắt kỹ thuật: Review code, viết tài liệu thiết kế, hướng dẫn thành viên junior; dùng AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex…) hiệu quả và lan tỏa cách làm cho team.

Job description
WE NEED YOU ON OUR TEAM!
We’re hiring a Staff Engineer to be the senior technical authority for AI across the organization. This is not a people-management role – it’s a consulting and architecture role with organization-wide reach: you design AI solutions, set the standards other engineers build to, drive evaluation discipline, and shape how AI enters our products from the design phase onward. You report directly to the CTO and multiply the impact of every squad working with AI.
What You’ll Do
• Advise and design AI solutions across the full spectrum – from single LLM calls to complex multi-agent infrastructure – recommending implementation approaches that account for fallbacks, cost/latency budgets, and rate-limit constraints (throttling, TPM/RPM).
• Architect agentic systems with the right structure for the problem: MCP server design, deterministic workflows, single agents with tool access, orchestrator–worker or A2A multi-agent topologies.
• Own the evaluation practice that drives technical decisions: eval sets, scoring rubrics, and regression measurement for non-deterministic outputs – and use that evidence to settle when to prompt, when to RAG, when to fine-tune, and when to build an agent, so architecture choices are backed by measurement rather than intuition.
• Partner with Product from the design phase: consult on where AI genuinely adds value in a feature, what’s feasible at what cost, and what the failure modes will look like – so AI capability shapes the product spec instead of being retrofitted after.
• Forecast the direction of AI in the next 2-3 years, and start to take actions today so Perform.AI remains technologically relevant in that future.
• Raise the technical level of engineers across squads: review their designs and code before implementation, define shared standards they follow (prompt conventions, eval-driven development), design and deliver internal AI training programs, and make architecture decisions the whole team builds on.
Your skills and experience
WHAT YOU SHOULD BRING ALONG!
Core Qualifications
• 8+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years building and operating LLM-based systems in production.
• Hands-on experience designing and running LLM-based systems in production – beyond API calls: handling fallbacks, cost/latency trade-offs, rate limits (TPM/RPM), and structured output reliability at scale.
• Experience building multi-step agentic systems and choosing the right topology for the problem – using frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph or equivalents (LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, Claude Agents SDK), with working knowledge of MCP, context/state management, and agent failure modes.
• Demonstrated evaluation discipline for non-deterministic systems: building eval sets, defining scoring rubrics (including LLM-as-judge approaches), measuring regression – using tools like LangSmith, Langfuse, or equivalents – and using eval evidence to drive architecture decisions (prompt vs. RAG vs. fine-tune vs. agent).
• Strong backend fundamentals with the depth to drive the tech stack, not just work within it: expert-level Python, distributed systems, high-volume data pipelines, and the judgment to select and standardize frameworks, libraries, and infrastructure for AI workloads across the team.
Nice to Have
• Experience in logistics, e-commerce, or other high-volume data domains.
• Contributions to open source, technical writing, or conference talks.
• Experience fine-tuning models (managed fine-tuning APIs or open-weight approaches like LoRA/PEFT) and judging when fine-tuning beats prompting or RAG on cost and quality.
• Experience across the LLM deployment spectrum: working with managed cloud LLM services (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, or equivalent) – quotas, regional availability, model version management – familiarity with deploying open-weight models (e.g., Llama, Qwen from Hugging Face) on your own infrastructure with an understanding of the cost/control trade-offs between the two.

Job description
HRS AS A COMPANY
HRS is a global technology company transforming how businesses manage lodging and meetings through AI-driven, data-centric solutions. With more than 50 years of experience, HRS serves global enterprises, hotel partners, and business travelers through Lodging-as-a-Service, Meeting-as-a-Service, and Workforce-as-a-Service offerings.
BUSINESS UNIT
The Search & Book unit at HRS plays a pivotal role in delivering innovative solutions through HRS Connect, the company's flagship product within the expansive global corporate travel management market. HRS Connect specifically targets the rapidly growing and significantly underserved segments of corporate lodging, meetings, groups, and long stays. The unit develops, enhances, and maintains complex technology solutions that seamlessly integrate hotel distribution systems, Property Management Systems (PMS), Online Travel Agencies (OTA), and Hotel Chain systems into the HRS Connect platform. Leveraging robust connectivity, innovative technology, and data-driven insights, the unit ensures seamless connectivity, optimized travel spend, enhanced traveler experiences, and high-performance booking solutions for global enterprise customers.
POSITION
A Senior Fullstack Engineer (AI-Native) builds production-grade applications and intelligent workflows with an AI-first mindset across the full software development lifecycle. This role is for an engineer who does not treat AI as an add-on, but as a core way of working across design, implementation, testing, documentation, debugging, and delivery.
The ideal candidate consistently approaches work by asking whether a task can be completed entirely with AI or materially improved through AI-assisted execution, while still applying strong engineering judgment and quality controls.
CHALLENGE

Job description
1. Phân tích bài toán và thiết kế giải pháp GenAI
• Làm việc với các đơn vị nghiệp vụ để tiếp nhận yêu cầu, đánh giá khả năng ứng dụng GenAI và đề xuất hướng tiếp cận kỹ thuật phù hợp.
• Phân tích bối cảnh sử dụng, dữ liệu đầu vào/đầu ra và rủi ro để thiết kế kiến trúc GenAI khả thi, an toàn.
• Lựa chọn mô hình, nền tảng và phương thức triển khai (on-premise, private cloud, hybrid, API service) phù hợp với từng bài toán.
2. Phát triển và triển khai các dịch vụ GenAI
• Thiết kế và triển khai giải pháp GenAI trên nền tảng mô hình mã nguồn mở hoặc dịch vụ API bên ngoài (ví dụ: OpenAI, Gemini hoặc tương đương), tuân thủ chính sách bảo mật và quản trị rủi ro của Ngân hàng.
• Đóng gói ứng dụng GenAI thành dịch vụ (API/microservice) để tích hợp với hệ thống nghiệp vụ, cổng nội bộ và nền tảng số.
3. Phát triển giải pháp RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
• Thiết kế và triển khai pipeline RAG, bao gồm thu thập, tiền xử lý, indexing và truy xuất tri thức từ dữ liệu nội bộ.
• Kết hợp LLM với semantic search/vector database nhằm đảm bảo phản hồi đúng ngữ cảnh, bám sát dữ liệu nội bộ và hạn chế hallucination.
• Phối hợp với Data Governance và BI để đảm bảo dữ liệu sử dụng cho RAG được phân loại, cấp quyền và kiểm soát theo quy định.
4. Phát triển AI Agent và tự động hóa thông minh
• Thiết kế và triển khai AI Agent/Agentic Workflow thực hiện chuỗi tác vụ từ tiếp nhận yêu cầu, truy xuất, phân tích, phản hồi đến thực hiện hành động.
• Tích hợp GenAI với các công cụ workflow automation (ví dụ: n8n hoặc nền tảng tương đương) nhằm tự động hóa quy trình nội bộ và hỗ trợ các tác vụ lặp lại.
• Chuẩn hóa Agent và Workflow để tái sử dụng, mở rộng và triển khai trong toàn Ngân hàng.
5. Giám sát, kiểm soát và cải tiến ứng dụng GenAI
• Thiết lập monitoring, logging và đánh giá chất lượng ứng dụng GenAI về độ chính xác, mức độ phù hợp ngữ cảnh, hallucination, hiệu năng và độ trễ.
• Theo dõi chi phí sử dụng mô hình, tài nguyên hệ thống và tối ưu hiệu năng, chi phí vận hành.
• Cải tiến prompt, pipeline và logic Agent khi dữ liệu hoặc yêu cầu nghiệp vụ thay đổi.

Job description
About Us
We are a cybersecurity company building AI-native security platforms that span both offensive and defensive operations:
• Offensive Platform — An autonomous security platform that uses agentic AI to continuously penetration-test APIs, web applications, and cloud infrastructure. It validates vulnerabilities, chains attack paths, and generates audit-ready reports — all with human-in-the-loop safety
controls.
• Defensive Platform — A role-based AI SOC platform where specialized agents (SOC Manager, Analyst, Incident Response, Threat Hunter) work as a coordinated crew to triage alerts, investigate incidents, hunt threats, and manage Detection-as-Code — at machine speed, under human oversight.
We are not building wrappers around ChatGPT. We are building autonomous, multi-step AI agent systems that reason, plan, use tools, and take real-world action in high-stakes security environments.
The Role
As an Agentic AI Engineer, you will design, build, and ship the autonomous AI agent systems at the core of our products. Depending on your background and interest, you'll work on one or both of the following:
Offensive Security Agents: You'll build the agent brain that plans multi-step attack strategies, generates auditable configuration files, orchestrates security tool execution (Nmap, Nuclei, Nessus, custom exploits), validates discovered vulnerabilities, and chains minor findings into critical attack paths — all within a human-in-the-loop approval framework.
Defensive Security Agents: You'll build the specialized SOC agents that autonomously triage and correlate alerts, enrich events with contextual data, summarize investigations, propose detection rules, execute threat hunting queries, and recommend incident response actions — while keeping analysts in control of final decisions.
What You'll Do
• Design and implement autonomous agent architectures that handle multi-step reasoning, tool use, memory, and planning in production security workflows
• Build reliable agent loops with proper error handling, retry logic, guardrails, and human-inthe-loop approval gates for high-risk actions
• Develop dynamic tool-calling pipelines where agents select, configure, and orchestrate external security tools based on contextual analysis
• Engineer prompt chains and agent reasoning strategies across multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Anthropic Claude) with model-agnostic abstractions
• Build and maintain the context layer that gives agents awareness of users, assets, past incidents, typical behavior, and environmental state
• Design evaluation frameworks to measure agent reliability, accuracy, and safety — especially for high-stakes actions like exploit execution or incident response recommendations
• Collaborate with security engineers to translate offensive and defensive domain expertise into agent behavior, tool profiles, and decision logic
• Optimize for latency, cost, and token efficiency in production agent workloads
• Support on-premise deployments using self-hosted open-source models (DeepSeek, Llama) for air-gapped enterprise customers
Your skills and experience
Must Have
• 4+ years of software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Python
• 1+ year of hands-on experience building LLM-powered agent systems — not chatbots, but agents that reason, plan, use tools, and take multi-step actions
• Deep working knowledge of at least one agentic framework: LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent
• Experience with tool-calling / function-calling patterns, including dynamic tool selection and chaining
• Solid understanding of prompt engineering for complex reasoning tasks — chain-of-thought, ReAct, plan-and-execute patterns
• Experience integrating with multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and managing model-agnostic abstractions
• Ability to build robust, production-grade systems — not just prototypes. You think about failure modes, retries, timeouts, guardrails, and observability
• Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, async programming, and API design
Strong Plus
• Background in cybersecurity — offensive (pentesting, vulnerability assessment, red teaming) or defensive (SOC operations, SIEM, detection engineering, incident response)
• Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK framework, Sigma rules, or detection-as-code practices
• Experience deploying and fine-tuning open-source LLMs (Llama, DeepSeek, Mistral) for onpremise or air-gapped environments
• Knowledge of graph databases (Neo4j) for modeling attack paths or entity relationships
• Experience building multi-agent systems where multiple specialized agents collaborate, delegate, and share context
• Familiarity with RAG pipelines, vector databases, and knowledge retrieval systems
Mindset
• You're excited about building AI systems that take real action in the world, not just generate text
• You have a strong security intuition — you think about what can go wrong, what an adversary would do, and where guardrails are needed
• You're comfortable with ambiguity and can translate vague domain requirements into concrete agent behaviors
• You care about reliability over cleverness — a working agent that handles edge cases beats a flashy demo
Why you'll love working here
• Opportunity to build AI agent systems for two products simultaneously — offensive and defensive security — a rare engineering challenge
• Direct influence on product architecture and AI strategy from day one
• Work with a team that understands both security and AI deeply
• Competitive compensation

HRS AS A COMPANY
HRS reinvents how businesses Work, Stay and Pay. Counting more than 5.000 corporations and 40 % of Fortune 500 companies in our customer base, HRS has emerged to the most trusted platform of digital software solutions in business travel hospitality worldwide. The HRS platform is composed of three engines that each optimize one core building block along the corporate hospitality supply chain: Intelligent Procurement, Smart Booking and Invisible Payment. Through the integration of those engines into one large data-driven platform approach, our Lodging-as-a-Service value proposition enhances satisfaction of corporate employees and travelers, delivers the highest grade of process automation for corporate stakeholders and ensures strongest compliance end-to-end.
BUSINESS UNIT
Enterprise Solutions is a business unit in HRS which integrates multiple solutions through the interchange of information from various business processes and related databases. Working in Enterprise Solutions means working on our core systems which enable our business processes on a daily basis.
Pay2Reclaim platform is at the core of HRS’s value proposition—simplifying travel payments, automating invoicing, and transforming spend data into actionable insights. Key HRS innovations such as seamless payments, automated invoice validation, fully eligible VAT reclaim, and actionable spend data insights are all powered by the Pay2Reclaim platform.
These capabilities not only drive bottom-line improvements and ensure regulatory compliance for our customers but also play a critical role in enabling HRS’s go-to-market strategy. As Pay adoption grows, it strengthens our global partner ecosystem—unlocking network effects that drive greater value and scalability across the platform. Pay2Reclaim doesn’t just support the travel experience; it powers a strategic financial layer that helps enterprises manage risk, reclaim costs, and optimize spend.
As a member of the Pay2Reclaim teams, you’ll operate at the crossroads of travel and finance, helping some of the world’s leading businesses streamline complex payment flows and gain control over their global travel spend - with visibility, automation, and intelligence at every step.
POSITION
We are looking for an Engineering Team Lead to lead a high-performing engineering team to develop an AI-agentic wallet platform, where autonomous AI agents orchestrate the end-to-end lifecycle of corporate spending through event-driven workflows, replacing manual operations and enabling real-time, compliant, and personalized experiences.

Job description

Newage Group thành lập năm 2006, phân phối đồ gia dụng với các thương hiệu Fujihome, FujiE, Andbon, Advindeq và phân phối Honeywell. Làm chủ toàn bộ phần mềm của tập đoàn: tiếp quản, vận hành và phát triển các hệ thống nội bộ, đặc biệt là dẫn dắt các dự án lớn như ERP. • Chuyển đổi dữ liệu từ hệ thống cũ sang hệ thống mới, đối chiếu số liệu với Kế toán.
• Vận hành các hệ thống đang chạy: sửa lỗi, sao lưu, bảo mật, phân quyền, quản lý chi phí dịch vụ.

• Viết tài liệu kỹ thuật và quy tắc làm việc với AI (prompt, skill, agent) để người sau có thể tiếp quản.
• Báo cáo tiến độ hằng tuần cho Chủ tịch; đề xuất mở rộng đội ngũ khi dự án lớn dần.
Your skills and experience
• Đã tự xây và đưa vào sử dụng ít nhất 1–2 sản phẩm thật (web, app, dashboard, công cụ nội bộ) bằng AI; có link chạy được để giới thiệu.
• Thành thạo làm việc với Claude / Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT/Codex: viết yêu cầu rõ, chia nhỏ việc, đọc lỗi và hướng dẫn AI sửa đến khi chạy đúng.
• Đọc hiểu được code và SQL ở mức cơ bản để kiểm tra kết quả AI làm ra: hiểu cơ sở dữ liệu (bảng, quan hệ, giao dịch), API, Git/GitHub, cách đưa sản phẩm lên mạng (Cloudflare, Supabase, Vercel…).

• Có nền tảng lập trình (TypeScript/JavaScript, React, SQL, Python) - từng học CNTT.
• Đã làm hoặc dùng sâu ERP, phần mềm bán hàng, quản lý kho, hệ thống thương mại điện tử.
• Đã kết nối API sàn (Shopee, TikTok Shop, Lazada), Sapo, hóa đơn điện tử.
• Đã dùng MCP, agent AI, Claude Projects/Skills để tự động hoá công việc.

Job Summary: The DevSecOps Engineer is responsible for embedding security at every stage of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) - from initial design and development to deployment and operations. This role introduces processes, tools, and methodologies that prioritize secure coding practices, infrastructure hardening, automated compliance, and proactive threat detection, while supporting scalability and continuous delivery in cloud-native environments.
Essential Functions:
• Infrastructure Design & Automation: Design, implement, and maintain secure infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) with a focus on compliance, cost efficiency, and security
• Security Integration: Develop and enforce security controls within CI/CD pipelines, integrating automated scanning tools (e.g., SAST, DAST, SCA) to detect vulnerabilities and ensure secure deployments
• Cloud Management: Architect and manage secure cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), including containerized workloads with hardened images and Kubernetes security policies
• Monitoring & Incident Response: Implement and manage logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions (e.g., SIEM tools, Prometheus, Grafana) for threat detection and incident response
• Collaboration & Culture: Promote secure development practices, train teams on emerging security methodologies, and collaborate with stakeholders to ensure security by design
• Cost Management: Monitor and optimize cloud costs while maintaining security compliance

• Automation & Scripting: Skilled in scripting languages (Bash, Python, PowerShell) for automation and system integration

Who We Are & How We Work
We’re on a mission to make employment easier and more valuable for everyone. Our Employment Operating System brings hiring, HR, payroll and benefits into one platform, supporting over 350,000 businesses and 2.5 million employees worldwide.
We’re a Mission First, Remote First and AI First company, guided by our values and a commitment to high performance.
Our Engineering team follows a one problem, one engineer approach. With AI coding agents at the core of how we build, Engineers own problems end-to-end, from understanding customer needs and designing solutions to delivering them into production. We start with the smallest working solution and continuously improve it, giving Engineers the autonomy to make decisions and create meaningful product impact.

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer, you’ll build and improve the systems behind our Employment Operating System, delivering reliable solutions that make a difference for millions of users.
We’re looking for someone with solid backend expertise, a problem-solving mindset and a passion for building great products, who’s ready to take ownership and grow in an AI-first engineering environment.

• Own product problems end-to-end, from understanding requirements and designing solutions to development, testing and production deployment.

• Solve technical challenges, improve application performance and deliver practical, maintainable solutions.

Your skills and experience
• Tốt nghiệp đại học chuyên ngành về công nghệ thông tin.
• Có ít nhất 5 năm kinh nghiệm cho Senior làm việc liên quan đến chuyên môn Backend sử dụng ngôn ngữ lập trình Java.
• Nắm vững system design và architectural patterns: microservices, event sourcing, saga pattern, circuit breaker, outbox pattern, distributed tracing, metrics (Prometheus/Grafana), structured logging, alerting, ...
• Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với một số cơ sở dữ liệu như MySQL, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, ClickHouse, Redis, MongoDB, KVRocks, Message Queue (Kafka, ...)
• Có kiến thức về application security và secure coding practices (OWASP Top 10, secrets management, mã hóa dữ liệu).
• Nắm vững kiến thức về cấu trúc dữ liệu và giải thuật, Authen & Author, OOP, API Restful, Thrift/gRPC, UnitTest, ...
• Có tinh thần chủ động, làm việc độc lập, kĩ năng giải quyết vấn đề.
• Có kinh nghiệm xây dựng ứng dụng chịu tải cao, lưu trữ dữ liệu phân tán, xử lý dữ liệu giao dịch và xử lý bất đồng bộ.
• Có kinh nghiệm sử dụng AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code...). Có khả năng kiểm chứng, tối ưu output của AI để đảm bảo an toàn và chất lượng code, chủ động đề xuất AI workflow phù hợp.
• Kinh nghiệm mentoring, dẫn dắt technical decision, làm việc với stakeholders là điểm cộng lớn.

Job description
Scandinavian Software Park is the Hanoi-based tech hub and home to several of Scandinavia’s market-leading B2B SaaS companies. Founded and operated by Monterro, the leading B2B software investor in the Nordics, Scandinavian Software Park enables portfolio companies to accelerate growth and build high-end engineering and product capabilities in Vietnam. This role sits within our product services, aiming to delivering expert-level services directly to Monterro’s portfolio of 30+ B2B software companies.
This is a senior individual contributor role for a seasoned security professional who brings deep offensive and defensive expertise and can operate independently across multiple complex engagements. As a Cyber Security Specialist, you will be a key technical authority, leading continuous vulnerability intelligence operations, conducting advanced penetration tests and code security reviews, and advising on the security of AI-powered features across Monterro’s portfolio of Nordic B2B SaaS products. You are also expected to bring the judgment and seniority to triage ambiguous findings, lead threat modeling sessions, support incident response and raise the security maturity of the products you work with.
What you’ll do
Penetration Testing
• Map the environment of each portfolio company, including LLMs, prompts, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, APIs and connected systems, to define a precise attack surface before testing begins.
• Plan and execute full-scope penetration tests against web applications, APIs, and internal systems for portfolio companies, from scoping and reconnaissance through to exploitation and reporting.
• Stress-test system behavior under real-world adversarial conditions, evaluating how models and agents respond to manipulation, privilege abuse, and unexpected inputs.
Red Teaming
• Conduct threat intelligence-led OSINT reconnaissance to map each portfolio company’s digital footprint, identify exposed assets, and define realistic attack scenarios grounded in how real adversaries operate.
• Execute multi-vector attack simulations combining external and internal network exploitation, social engineering, phishing, and lateral movement to reveal how far an attacker could realistically penetrate.
• Run both Full Simulation engagements (end-to-end attack chain from initial access to exfiltration) and Assumed Compromise scenarios (focused on lateral movement and detection/response after access).
• Validate detection and response capabilities: evaluate whether security controls, monitoring, and incident response processes would catch and contain a real attack.
Code-Based Security Review
• Lead in-depth security reviews of application codebases, identifying logic flaws, injection vulnerabilities, broken authentication, insecure data handling and supply-chain risks.
• Apply AI-assisted static analysis alongside manual review techniques to achieve deeper coverage across multiple languages and frameworks.
• Delivery findings with severity ratings, exploitability assessments and precise remediation guidance; present results directly to engineering leads and CTOs.
Threat Modeling
• Lead threat modeling sessions (STRIDE, PASTA, or equivalent) with portfolio company product and engineering teams during design and architecture phases, not just after the fact.
• Translate threat models into actionable security requirements, test cases, and backlog items that engineering teams can act on.
• Build and maintain threat profiles for portfolio companies, updating them as products evolve and new attack surfaces emerge.
System Security
• Assess the security of AI-powered product features – covering prompt injections, indirect prompt injection, model data leakage, insecure LLM integrations and adversarial input scenarios.
• Stay current on the evolving AI threat landscape (OWASP LLM Top 10, emerging jailbreak patterns, supply-chain risks in AI frameworks) and translate findings into practical guidance.
Your skills and experience
What we are looking for
Requirements:
• 5+ years of hands-on experience in application security, penetration testing or vulnerability management.
• Solid experience conducting vulnerability assessments and penetration tests on web applications and APIs with the ability to deliver professional reports independently.
• Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10 and OWASP LLM Top 10, web and API vulnerability classes, authentication and authorization flaws and business logic abuse.
• Experience with red teaming that covers traditional adversarial operations (threat intelligence-led attack planning, OSINT reconnaissance, multi-vector simulations and detection/response validation) and AI-specific targets (LLM jailbreaks, prompt injection, and adversarial testing of generative AI features in production).
• Experience leading threat modeling sessions (STRIDE, PASTA, or equivalent) with engineering and product teams.
• Familiarity with AI/LLM security risks: prompt injection, model data leakage, insecure LLM integrations and adversarial scenarios.
• Strong code review skills across multiple languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Go, C#) – able to identify vulnerabilities in unfamiliar codebases independently.
• Experience with AI-assisted or automated security tooling (e.g., Semgrep, Snyk, GitHub Advanced Security…) and the judgment to critically evaluate their output.
• Cloud penetration testing experience (AWS, Azure, GCP) and container/Kubernetes security.
• Understanding of B2B SaaS security patterns: multi-tenancy, OAuth/OIDC, API authentication and cloud-native privilege models.
• Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.
Nice to have
• OSCP, OSWoE, GPEN, GWAPT, or equivalent offensive security certification
• Experience with TIBER-EU or ART (Advanced Red Teaming) frameworks.
• Knowledge of compliance and risk frameworks relevant to Nordic/European software companies: ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, NIS2.
• Prior experience working with B2B SaaS or Nordic/European software companies is a strong plus

• You get to work at the actual intersection of AI and offensive security, not just reading about it, but testing it against real products in production.
• Full access to the best AI-assisted security tooling, no personal budget worries, no approval process, no waiting.

Job description
About Flexspace AI
• Flexspace AI is the e-commerce + AI revenue platform for coworking — / Shopify / Airbnb for flexible workspace. Seed-funded. We turn operators' websites into high-converting storefronts and run AI agents that price and market their inventory in real time.
• What we ship : mobile-first booking engine that embeds in any operator's site; SmartPricing Agent for dynamic pricing on meeting rooms, day passes, offices; SmartMarketing Agent for promo campaigns; operator dashboard for revenue/bookings/attribution; member portal for end customers; two-way integrations with prominent property management systems.
• Who buys it : coworking operators from single-location indies to multi-country brands. Their revenue is the conversion rate of the screens you'll design — CTAs, catalog, transitions, and checkout aren't decoration here; they're the product.
• How we work : small, agile, AI-heavy. On track to profitability this year. Headcount is deliberately small so each person owns real surface area — tight feedback loops, no bureaucracy, no committees. We measure shipped work — funnel lifts, partner themes shipped, UX issues triaged — not hours. No face-time theater.
• Co-located hybrid out of Workflow Thao Dien in HCMC for in-person speed. Wider team is async-first, written-first across US, Israel, Turkey, Philippines, and Vietnam. Weekly product/design sync with the CTO/cofounder — no layers between you and the people deciding what to build.
Role Overview
Product Engineer building the e-commerce platform behind the next generation of coworking spaces—SmartPricing, SmartMarketing, the booking engine operators embed on their sites, and the integrations that tie it all together. You work directly with the founders, with no layers between you and the people setting the roadmap. We also welcome final-year students looking for an internship.
• What engineering means here. The hard problem isn't writing code—AI writes plenty of it now. It's deciding what's worth building. Operators juggle hundreds of spaces, prices, members, bookings, and integrations across locations and time zones; customers comparing meeting rooms decide in seconds. Your job is to understand these humans—in the data—then ship software that moves their revenue. Empathy and data are the input; working product is the output. Polish comes last.
• On prioritization. Not all code has the same payoff. You'll look at a problem from several angles—funnel data, operator feedback, revenue, churn signals—and pick the work where your hours move the business most. A feature nobody uses is wasted hours; a 2% lift on the booking funnel is the company's quarter. Judgment over completeness.
• On decisions. Bigger calls go to the team before you build. Smaller calls—ship, watch the data, iterate. We're data-driven, not opinion-driven, and seniority doesn't win arguments—evidence does. You'll own the surfaces you touch, with support, and you expose your reasoning so we can calibrate together.
• On growth. You're early-career, and we hire for that on purpose. Expect code review, pairing, and direct coaching from founders and senior engineers. We can teach the stack, the patterns, and the product thinking. The one thing we can't give you is drive—that comes from you.
What You'll Do
• Ship features end-to-end. Work with founders and operators to understand a need, then spec, build, and release it—with support along the way.
• Build and evolve our SmartPricing & SmartMarketing agents. Pricing rules, targeting logic, and performance monitoring.
• Make booking effortless. Seamless booking experiences with instant payment, embedded right in operators' websites.
• Wire up integrations. Sync data with coworking CRMs, inventory systems, and analytics tools—and prevent double bookings.
• Pull data, form an opinion, decide. Revenue, Mixpanel, GA4 / GTM funnel data, and operator feedback.
• Write so the team stays in sync. Clear specs and pull-request descriptions that keep an async, distributed team aligned across time zones.
How You'll Work With AI
Claude as peers, not novelties. You'll write and refine structured prompts, build new ones, and ship real changes through AI tools. Senior engineers coach you and set guardrails so you can move fast without first becoming a framework expert. Judgment, taste, and clear thinking are the bottleneck now—not syntax. We give you a budget for the best AI tools because we expect you to use them as leverage, not as a crutch.
What Success Looks Like In Your First 6 Months
• You've shipped real features to production that operators and members actually use.
• You can navigate the codebase and pick up unfamiliar areas without much hand-holding.
• You ship changes through Claude with sound judgment about what to accept and what to rework.
• You back your decisions and pushback with data—and your written updates keep the async team moving without meetings.
• You're catching product, UX, and trade-off issues early, not just implementing tickets.
What Makes You a Great Fit
We prioritize these qualities top-down—technical skills can be learned quickly by sharp, curious people with low ego and a strong work ethic. Above all, here's what we look for:
• Drive and motivation. We can give you the tools, the environment, and hands-on coaching—but we can't give you the drive to succeed as a product engineer in the modern AI era. That has to come from you.
• Attention to detail and high standards. You're obsessed with quality—it's not about just getting the job done, it's about delivering the best work you can and raising the team's bar. You sweat the small things—edge cases, copy, data correctness—because details separate a working product from a trusted one.
• Clear written English. You read and write clear English (with the help with AI tools); in an async, globally distributed team, your writing is how you think, collaborate, and lead.
• High agency. You take initiative—ask questions when something's unclear, chase down answers, and push your work forward instead of waiting to be told the next step.
• You question everything. Everyone has a voice and is expected to push the envelope. There's no "the senior person knows better"—answers and pushback alike are grounded in data and critical thinking, regardless of title or age.
• Curiosity and fast learning. You pick up new domains, tools, and concepts quickly, especially around AI, pricing, and B2B SaaS.
• Product sense. You care about customers and business context, not just the tech stack, and you treat engineering as a way to drive revenue, bookings, and occupancy. You grasp basic microeconomics—incentives, opportunity cost, supply and demand—as a toolkit for trade-offs: simpler designs that still maximize value, arguments made in terms of impact rather than opinion, and an understanding of why the business prioritizes what it does. Don't have this thinking framework yet? If you bring the motivation, we'll coach you on it.

Job description
Founded in 2016, Katalon is the category leader in AI-augmented software testing, empowering hybrid testers—those blending manual, automation, and AI skills—to deliver exceptional digital experiences. Katalon enables software teams of any size to deliver world-class customer experiences faster, easier, and more efficiently.
Since its first launch, Katalon has experienced tremendous growth, serving more than 30,000 teams across 80+ countries, many of which are in the Fortune Global 500. Katalon has been named a G2 Leader in software testing for 11 consecutive quarters and a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years.
About the role
Katalon's IT & Digital Transformation team runs the internal technology for our people across Vietnam, the US and remote locations. We are a small team that works agent-first: we run IT through APIs, scripts and AI agents, not through click-ops and ticket queues.
We are looking for an engineer to own IT Operations in our HCMC office — the service desk, identity and devices, onboarding and offboarding, and the office network and server room. You will be the go-to owner for this domain, run projects on your own, and use automation and AI to keep a large scope manageable.
We hire for growth. You likely started on the service desk and have already begun to own sysadmin work: a firewall rule, the office WiFi, a VPN, a server, the backups. This role gives you the full scope and the title to match. You do not need to know all of it on day one; you need to want it and learn fast.
What you will own
From day one
• Service desk: the IT request queue, floor support, meeting-room and event AV.
• Onboarding and offboarding: accounts, devices, access, licences and data handover — complete and evidenced.
• Identity: Google Workspace administration.
• Devices: a Mac-first laptop fleet with some Windows, managed through MDM; endpoint security and the hardware asset register.
• Network and server room, first line: collect the data, find the cause, make safe changes with a written plan and a rollback. Enterprise firewall, WiFi and switching; virtualisation, storage, power and backups.
• On-call: office emergencies; paid overtime when an incident or event needs it.
Within your first six months
• Network and server room, full ownership: firewall policy, WiFi, VPN and backups — end to end, under change control.
• Vendors: day-to-day owner for IT vendors and service providers — quotes, tickets, invoices, renewals.
• Compliance: first-line security-compliance evidence (for example SOC 2): access reviews and device controls.
• Licences: SaaS seat hygiene and renewals.
• Cloud housekeeping: OAuth clients, API access, billing and access for our cloud tenants.
• Physical security: office access control and cameras.
• Documentation and automation: runbooks for the systems you own; automate recurring service-desk and lifecycle work.
Your skills and experience
What we need from you (must-have)
• 3+ years in IT , including service-desk work, with growing ownership since then (things you built, migrated or ran, not only tickets).
• Hands-on sysadmin exposure in at least one of: firewall, WiFi, VPN, servers, backups. You can tell the story of a problem you fixed yourself.
• The drive to grow into a sysadmin / IT-ops owner role.
• You enjoy service work. Users come first. This role keeps the service desk; it grows your scope, it does not take you away from users.
• Workspace admin (Google Workspace, or Microsoft 365 / Entra ID and a will to switch) and identity basics (SSO/SAML, OAuth, least privilege).
• MDM experience (Jamf, Intune or similar) and device-fleet support.
• Real AI use, with examples (MUST). You use AI tools in your daily IT work to troubleshoot, script, document and automate. Not for show, and not only when someone makes you. Your application MUST include 1–2 short examples: the problem, how you used AI, and the result.
• Scripting in Bash, Python or PowerShell.
• Careful change habits: one change at a time, a rollback ready, a written record.
• Root-cause mindset: you prove a cause with data before you call it.
• High agency: you find and close problems without being chased.
• Good written and spoken English; Vietnamese for local vendors.
• 100% on-site in our HCMC office. Work starts at 9am (sometimes 8am for events). Some evenings past 8pm for maintenance. On-call for emergencies, sometimes in US hours or at weekends. Paid OT.
Nice to have
• Deeper network skills: firewall policies, SD-WAN, enterprise WiFi, VLANs, RF troubleshooting.
• Apple fleet management; Google Workspace admin.
• A home lab, a GitHub, a blog or anything else that shows you build things.
• ITSM platform admin (Jira Service Management or similar): request types, workflows, SLAs, automation.
• Security-compliance evidence work (SOC 2, ISO 27001).
• Virtualisation and backup tools; physical access-control systems.
• Cloud identity and IAM (any major cloud).
• Vendor and procurement experience.
• Workflow automation tools; AWS basics.
• Networking, security, MDM or Google Workspace certifications.
How to apply
Send your CV with 1–2 short examples of how you used AI in your IT work: the problem, what you did with AI, and the result. A link, a screenshot or a few lines of text is enough. Applications without examples will not move forward.
What success looks like
• 30 days: you have access to every system you own, you know the vendors, and you keep the network and server-room documentation current.
• 90 days: you run the service-desk queue to agreed response times; you own onboarding and offboarding end to end, with evidence; you solve network issues to root cause with data, with a runbook for each.
• 6 months: you own network and server-room changes end to end, vendors and first-line compliance evidence; recurring service-desk and lifecycle work runs largely through automation.

• Provide Security Architecture thought leadership and subject-matter expertise to help business and project teams understand the security impacts of proposed system changes and solutions.

• Communications
• Configurations

• Manage significant architectural decisions to ensure secure outcomes and compliance with appropriate governance practices.
• Support required notifications and engagement with Technology Architecture Forums.

• Develop new security patterns that describe integration approaches, use cases, reusable components, and technical references for enterprise security capabilities.

• Support compliance with applicable internal security policies, governance requirements, and risk management expectations.
• Engage with business domain executives, Product Owners, technology delivery teams, Release Train Engineers, Architecture and Strategy teams, and Governance, Risk and Compliance stakeholders.
• Act as a trusted security adviser to both technical and business stakeholders.
• Influence the security aspects of relevant target-state architectures and central technology roadmaps.
• Coach and mentor others in the practical application of security and risk management concepts, principles, strategies, and relevant industry standards.
• Support the professional development of colleagues by sharing security knowledge and helping them develop relevant capabilities.

Quy trình phát triển an toàn (SSDLC)

• Kiến trúc tham chiếu bảo mật; biên bản review kiến trúc.

Kiểm thử bảo mật ứng dụng

• Kế hoạch kiểm thử năm; biên bản nghiệm thu dịch vụ pentest.

• Đánh giá, lựa chọn công cụ AppSec và lộ trình DevSecOps phù hợp với năng lực đội phát triển.
Kết quả đầu ra

Job description
About the job
Product Engineer
• AI-first engineering, uncompromising fundamentals. Accountable for the outcome, not the output.
• Full-time · On-site · Flexible working hours · Distributed, multi-timezone team · AI-first engineering · 3+ years experience
• The role is remote from your start date and becomes hybrid when our new office opens, expected around 20 December
Job Summary
We are hiring a Product Engineer - an engineer accountable for outcomes, not output .
We do not measure engineers by tickets closed or lines shipped. We measure them by whether the thing they built actually solved the user's problem. That means you will be expected to question requirements before building them, own a feature from ambiguity through to production behaviour, and stay attached to it after release - watching the metrics, the logs, and the support tickets.
You will work with Product Managers, designers, and business stakeholders based in different countries and timezones . Overlap hours are limited by design, so clear communication and the ability to move a decision forward asynchronously - without waiting for a meeting - matter as much as your engineering skill.
This is a deeply technical role with an AI-first mindset . AI coding agents are the default way we build here - you will spend more of your day designing architecture, steering agents, and reviewing generated code than typing implementations by hand. We expect fluency with spec-driven development, reusable agent skills, and context engineering, not occasional autocomplete use. Which is exactly why fundamentals and best practices matter more, not less , so you will be held to a high bar on SOLID, Clean Architecture, design patterns, distributed system design, relational data modelling, and automation testing: these are working knowledge, not résumé keywords, and you should expect to defend your choices reasonably in code review and in the interview.
You remain the author of record for everything that lands in main. "The agent wrote it" is never an acceptable explanation for a defect.
Key Responsibilities
• Own the outcome. Take a business problem from vague to shipped to measured . Define what success looks like with your Product Manager, instrument for it, and act on what the data says - including rolling back or rewriting your own work when the numbers disagree with the plan.
• Find the problem, not just the solution. Interrogate requirements before implementing them. Surface the cheaper path, the edge case nobody scoped, and the feature that shouldn't be built. Say so early and in writing.
• Collaborate across borders and timezones. Partner directly with Product Managers, designers, QA, and business stakeholders distributed across multiple countries. Write decisions down, keep specs and PR descriptions self-explanatory, unblock people in other timezones, and run the occasional early or late call when the others need it.
• Architect and build services and APIs. Design RESTful (and where appropriate, event-driven or gRPC) services applying SOLID, Clean/Hexagonal Architecture, and design patterns deliberately - with a clear justification for the boundaries you draw. Design normalised, indexed, migration-safe relational schemas that hold up under real query load. Architecture is the part an agent cannot infer for you: you set the boundaries and the contracts, then let agents fill them in.
• Design for distribution. Make grounded calls on monolith vs. microservices. Build services that satisfy 12-factor principles - externalised config, stateless processes, disposability, dev/prod parity - and containerise them for Docker/Kubernetes deployment.
• Automate the safety net. Own automated testing for what you build: unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end where it earns its keep. Tests ship in the same PR as the code, not in a follow-up ticket. A bug fix without a reproducing test is not a fix. In an AI-first workflow the test suite is the specification - it is what makes agent-generated change safe to merge at speed.
• Work AI-first, and hold the line on quality. Drive delivery with coding agents, know your acceptance criteria first, let agents execute, then review hard. Build and maintain reusable agent skills, project instructions, and guardrails so the whole team gains leverage - not just your own throughput. Reject output that is merely plausible: over-abstracted layers, duplicated logic, silently swallowed errors, tests that assert nothing. Never merge code you cannot explain line by line.
• Run what you ship. Instrument services with structured logging, metrics, and tracing. Debug production incidents, write the postmortem, and close the loop with a fix that prevents recurrence.
• Raise the team's bar. Review peers' PRs substantively, document trade-offs and decisions, and mentor on fundamentals and on responsible AI-assisted workflows.
Your skills and experience
Job Requirements
• 3+ years building and operating production backend services - and you can walk through a system you designed, why you designed it that way, and what you'd change now.
• Deep, demonstrable command of software design fundamentals: OOP, SOLID, Clean Architecture, and design patterns. You will be asked to critique a design and explain what breaks at scale. This is the non-negotiable core of the role - in an AI-first team, fundamentals are the review capability that keeps agent velocity from becoming agent debt.
• Strong RESTful API design: resource modelling, versioning, idempotency, pagination, error contracts, authentication/authorisation.
• Strong relational database design (PostgreSQL/MySQL): normalisation and when to break it, indexing strategy, transactions and isolation levels, query analysis, safe schema migrations.
• Microservices and 12-factor apps: service boundaries, inter-service communication, failure isolation, configuration and secrets management - plus honest judgment on when a monolith is the correct answer.
• Automation testing discipline: you write tests first or alongside, understand the test pyramid, and use test doubles without mocking away the thing under test. You treat coverage as a floor for confidence, never as a number to satisfy - and you can tell a genuine regression test from an agent-generated one that asserts nothing.
• Containerisation: confident with Docker; working knowledge of Kubernetes (deployments, services, config/secrets, health probes, resource limits).
• An AI-first way of working, already in your hands: real production experience with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent - including spec/context engineering, agent skills or custom commands, and a disciplined self-review process before any PR. You should be able to describe a time an agent produced plausible-but-wrong code, how you caught it, and which fundamental (a design principle, a data-model rule, a failing test) let you catch it.
• Product mindset with real ownership instincts: comfortable with ambiguity, able to talk to non-engineers about trade-offs in their language, and biased toward shipping something small to learn rather than debating something large.
• Effective asynchronous, cross-cultural collaboration: professional written English, the discipline to document context for people who are asleep when you're working, and comfort operating with stakeholders in several countries and timezones.
• Working frontend ability - React, Next.js, or Vue - enough to build and ship a full user-facing slice yourself.
Nice to Have
• Golang - our preferred backend language for new services.
• gRPC and HTTP/2 , including streaming and Server-Sent Events (SSE) for real-time and AI-streaming interfaces.
• ReactJS / NextJS at depth - SSR/RSC, routing, data fetching, performance.
• CI/CD pipeline ownership (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar) including automated quality and security gates.
• Infrastructure as Code - Terraform, Pulumi, or Helm.
• Service observability and SRE practice - OpenTelemetry, APM (Datadog / New Relic / Grafana stack), SLOs and error budgets, on-call and incident response.
• Message queues, background job processing, and event-driven architectures.
• SaaS products, media streaming (HLS/M3U8), or prior experience in a distributed international team.
Why you'll love working here
What We Offer
• Office pantry, adjustable height desk, monitors, entertaining area, etc at office.
• Flexible working hours - we care when your work lands and how it performs, not when you were online.
• A genuinely international team - you'll work with product and business colleagues across multiple countries.
• Team building activities and company trips.

Job description
ROLE OVERVIEW
• We are looking for a proactive, skilled, and detail-oriented Python AI Cloud Engineer – Azure (Middle) with 3 to 5 years of commercial software engineering experience to expand our Platform Engineering team. In this role, you will design, build, and operate Python serverless workflows on Azure Durable Functions and production AI agents on Microsoft Foundry and LangGraph, running inside a complex, network-isolated enterprise Azure landing zone.
• You will own long-running orchestrations, agentic workflows, and event-driven integrations end to end, connecting internal enterprise tools, Microsoft 365, and our central SAP ERP system. You will build the agent harness around our models (tools, memory, guardrails, evaluation, and observability) and work hands-on with the infrastructure underneath it all: hub-and-spoke virtual networks, private endpoints, hybrid connectivity to on-premises systems, identity, and governance.
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
• Durable Functions Development: Design and build Python workflows on Azure Functions and Durable Functions (orchestrator, activity, and entity functions) using patterns such as function chaining, fanout/fan-in, async HTTP APIs, monitors, and human interaction, with idempotent activities, retry policies, and safe versioning of long-running orchestrations.
• Backend & API Development: Build and maintain Python services and REST APIs (FastAPI, Azure Functions HTTP triggers) exposed through Azure API Management, with typed, tested, and documented code (type hints, Pydantic, OpenAPI).
• AI Agents & Agent Harness: Design and operate production AI agents with LangGraph and Microsoft Foundry (Foundry Agent Service, Azure OpenAI and other Foundry models), including the agent harness around them: tool / function calling against internal and SAP APIs, MCP servers, state and memory, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop approvals, and durable long-running agent execution on Durable Functions.
• RAG, Evaluation & Responsible AI: Build retrieval pipelines on Azure AI Search (hybrid / vector search, chunking, embeddings), set up offline and online evaluations and tracing in Foundry, and apply guardrails (Azure AI Content Safety, prompt-injection defenses, data-access boundaries); manage model deployments, quotas, latency, and token cost through private, Entra ID-secured Foundry endpoints.
• Cloud Infrastructure & Networking: Provision and operate a complex Azure landing zone with Bicep or Terraform: hub-and-spoke VNets, subnets and NSGs, Private Endpoints and Private DNS zones, VNet integration for Functions Premium / Flex Consumption plans, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway / Front Door with WAF, and hybrid connectivity (VPN Gateway / ExpressRoute) to on-premises systems, applying Azure Well-Architected Framework principles.
• Security, Identity & Governance: Secure workloads with Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, Azure Key Vault, Azure RBAC, and Azure Policy; enforce least-privilege access and private-only connectivity across subscriptions and environments.
• SAP & Enterprise Integration: Design, deploy, and monitor integration pipelines connecting internal applications to SAP S/4HANA / ECC and Microsoft 365 via OData (v2/v4), REST APIs, Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, and Logic Apps.
• CI/CD, Quality & Observability: Build and maintain Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments (environment promotion, staged / slot-based rollouts); maintain high test coverage with pytest; and implement structured logging, distributed tracing, dashboards, and alerting with Application Insights, Azure Monitor, and OpenTelemetry.
Your skills and experience
Must-have
• Python: Strong commercial experience with modern Python (3.10+), including asyncio, type hints, packaging and dependency management (uv, Poetry, or pip), and testing with pytest.
• Azure Functions & Durable Functions: Hands-on commercial experience building and operating Azure Functions in Python, including Durable Functions orchestrations in production, with a solid understanding of their constraints (deterministic orchestrator code, replay, idempotency, task hub storage, scaling, and hosting plans).
• AI Agents & LLM Engineering: Commercial experience shipping LLM-powered applications or agents to production in Python with LangGraph (or LangChain, Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel), including tool calling, structured outputs, RAG, and systematic evaluation, plus hands-on experience with Microsoft Foundry / Azure OpenAI model deployments.
• Azure Infrastructure & Networking: Proven experience setting up and troubleshooting non-trivial Azure environments (VNets, subnets, NSGs, Private Endpoints, Private DNS, VNet integration, routing and firewalls, hybrid connectivity) using infrastructure as code with Bicep or Terraform.
• API Design & Integration: Proven track record in designing, documenting (OpenAPI/Swagger), consuming, and securing RESTful APIs, webhooks, and message-based integrations (Service Bus, Event Grid, Storage queues).
• Databases: Strong practical experience with relational databases (Azure SQL Database, Azure Database for PostgreSQL), schema migrations (e.g., Alembic), query performance tuning, and Python data access (SQLAlchemy, pyodbc, or psycopg).
Nice-to-have
• AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate) certification.
• Microsoft Azure certifications such as AZ-204 (Azure Developer Associate), AZ-104 (Azure Administrator), AZ-700 (Azure Network Engineer Associate), or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert).
• Authentication and authorization with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), app registrations, MSAL, Managed Identities, Azure RBAC, PIM, and Azure Policy.
• Azure Landing Zones: Experience with the Cloud Adoption Framework, multi-subscription hub-andspoke or Azure Virtual WAN designs, and management-group level governance.
• Advanced Durable Functions: Experience with the Durable Task Scheduler or alternative storage providers (MSSQL, Netherite), Durable Entities for stateful coordination, and performance tuning of high-volume orchestrations.
• Enterprise & SAP Integration: Hands-on experience or solid working knowledge of enterprise application integration, particularly with SAP (OData v2/v4, REST endpoints, SAP Gateway, or BAPI/RFC) or similar ERPs, including via Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps SAP connector, API Management, On-premises Data Gateway).

• Agent Harness Engineering: Experience building agent runtimes or harnesses: tool sandboxing, context and memory management, retries and checkpointing, cost / token budgets, and agent observability with OpenTelemetry GenAI tracing or LangSmith.
• Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols, or Microsoft 365 Copilot / Teams agent extensibility.
• Experience with private networking for AI services (Foundry and Azure AI Search behind Private Endpoints, API Management as an AI gateway with token limits and load balancing).
CORE TECHNOLOGY STACK
• Compute & Backend: Python 3.11+, Azure Functions (Python v2 programming model), Azure Durable Functions (orchestrator, activity & entity functions), FastAPI, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Service.
• AI & Agents: Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry) & Foundry Agent Service, Azure OpenAI models, LangGraph / LangChain, Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Azure AI Search (vector & hybrid search), Azure AI Content Safety, Foundry evaluations & tracing.

• DevOps, Testing & Tooling: Azure DevOps, Bicep, Azure CLI, Docker, pytest, uv, Application Insights, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry.

Job description
🎯 Position Summary
• Are you a natural storyteller who loves creating content that resonates with real audiences? Are you also curious about how AI can help you work faster and think bigger? We're looking for a creative, detail-oriented individual to join our team as an AI Research & Content Generator — a content-first role where AI tools are your everyday assistant, not the main focus.
• In this role, you will plan and produce a wide variety of content for Athena's games and brand — from social media posts, short videos, marketing copy, and community content to blog articles and in-game text. You'll use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, and CapCut AI to speed up ideation, drafting, and production, while your own creative judgment, writing skills, and understanding of our audience remain the heart of every piece you ship. If you love writing, storytelling, and gaming culture — and see AI as a superpower rather than a subject — we want to hear from you.
🧠 Key Responsibilities
• Content Creation & Storytelling: Write, produce, and refine content across multiple formats — social media posts (Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Discord), marketing copy, blog articles, community announcements, store-listing content, and in-game text — that reflects Athena's tone and connects with our players.
• Brand Voice & Editorial Judgment: Ensure every piece of content sounds like Athena — consistent, engaging, and audience-appropriate. Make the final call on what's good enough to publish and what needs another pass.
• AI-Assisted Production: Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, CapCut AI, ElevenLabs, etc.) as your everyday assistant to speed up brainstorming, drafting, image mockups, video editing, and translation — always with a human eye on the final output.
• Content Planning: Contribute to the content calendar, propose ideas tied to game launches, events, community moments, and pop-culture trends. Turn briefs from Marketing and Game teams into ready-to-publish assets on time.
• Audience & Trend Research: Stay close to our players and the wider gaming community. Track what's resonating on social, in Discord — and translate those insights into better content.
• Light Performance Tracking: Review basic metrics (views, engagement, shares, comments) to understand what works and what doesn't. Use those learnings to improve the next round of content.
• Team Collaboration: Work closely with Marketing, Community, Art, and Game Design teams. Take direction, share drafts early, incorporate feedback quickly, and keep everyone in the loop.
Your skills and experience
• Strong Writing Skills: Excellent writing in Vietnamese (native-level) and English (Upper-Intermediate or higher). You can shift tone between engaging store-listing content based on given keywords (including App Name/Title, Description, and Visual Assets, etc.), playful social captions, professional press releases, and heartfelt community messages.
• Storytelling Instinct: A natural sense for what makes a story, a post, or a video actually engaging — not just informative. You've probably been writing, posting, or creating in some form for a while, even if just for fun.
• Content Portfolio: A portfolio is nice to have , but professional experience is not. Please share any content you've made — blog posts, social accounts you run, fanfiction, short videos, gaming reviews, Facebook Pages, TikToks, community posts, etc. We care about your voice and creativity more than your job title.
• Basic AI Tool Familiarity: Comfortable using at least 2–3 mainstream AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, CapCut AI) as part of your daily workflow. You don't need to be a prompt engineer — just curious, self-taught, and willing to keep learning.
• Love for Games & Pop Culture: A genuine interest in mobile, PC, or console games and the culture around them. You understand player language, memes, community dynamics, and what makes gamers care.
• Attention to Detail: Care about spelling, grammar, tone, and visual polish. You proofread before you publish.
• Eagerness to Learn: Open to feedback, quick to iterate, and excited to grow into a stronger content creator over time.
• Good Communication: Clear, friendly communication in English and/or Vietnamese within a team setting.
Preferred Qualifications (Bonus Points)
• Prior experience managing a social media account, Facebook Page, TikTok channel, YouTube channel, or Discord community (even personal ones count).
• Basic knowledge of SEO/ASO, social media best practices, or content performance metrics.
• Basic design or video editing skills (Canva, Photoshop, CapCut, Premiere).
• Familiarity with the gaming industry or streaming culture is a plus.
• Prior content, copywriting, community, or marketing experience — internship or freelance is welcome.
• Active presence in online communities (gaming forums, Discord servers, fandoms, creator platforms).
Why you'll love working here
• Gain hands-on experience with AI tools.
• Receive mentorship from industry-leading experts.
• Enjoy flexible working hours tailored to your schedule.

Job description
• Support users in using and operating Odoo and other company software.
• Develop new software applications and tools to meet departmental requirements.
• Work directly with users across departments to gather software development requirements, analyze business processes, and propose solutions to management.
• Develop and customize Odoo modules to meet business needs.
• Modify existing features and develop additional functionality in Odoo to support the workflows of Elasten, Citeco, and business units in Germany.
• Prepare user documentation, conduct training, and guide users on Odoo and other company software.
• Investigate and troubleshoot software issues, and update or correct data when errors occur.
• Prepare individual work plans and reports, and evaluate personal work performance.
• Propose initiatives to improve work quality and productivity.
• Perform other duties as assigned by the direct manager.
Your skills and experience
• Bachelor’s degree or higher in IT, Computer Science, Electronics and Telecommunications, or a related field.
• At least 5 years of software development experience, including 3 years in Odoo development/customization, with a lead or key role in at least 2 enterprise Odoo implementation projects.
• Proficiency in Python, PostgreSQL, and the Odoo framework, including ORM, QWeb, XML views, workflows, security, and reporting.
• Strong understanding of Odoo architecture and core modules: Accounting, Sales, Purchase, Inventory, Manufacturing, and HR; experience with Odoo implementation or upgrades.
• Knowledge of business analysis, system design, and third-party API/web service integration.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, advanced Excel, and AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot for coding, analysis, and daily work.
• Ability to read technical documentation in English and communicate at a basic level.
• Strong requirements gathering, problem-solving, communication, presentation, training, documentation, and cross-department collaboration skills.
• Honest, proactive, responsible, decisive, and detail-oriented; able to work independently, manage competing requests under pressure, and maintain data confidentiality.
• A systematic, solution-oriented approach, strong professional ethics, willingness to learn, and commitment to a long-term role.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Graduates of Hanoi University of Science and Technology, VNU University of Engineering and Technology, or Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology.
• Odoo certification or experience with an Odoo implementation partner.
• Familiarity with JavaScript/OWL, HTML/CSS, Git, Linux, and Docker.
• Experience developing internal tools, working in multi-company/multi-branch environments, or supporting manufacturing/trading businesses and their accounting, inventory, and sales processes.

Mo_Ta_Cong_Viec:
Job description
About the Role
You will own bonbon shop, our B2B platform connecting brands with retail outlets. That means owning the backlog, the requirements, and what gets shipped. You will work closely with the Product Manager on the product’s direction and on key decisions with enterprise clients.
Every enterprise client runs their business differently, and each will ask for things the product can’t do yet. We see these requests as the best source of insight into what the product should become. If you enjoy turning real client problems into product capabilities, you will thrive here.
How this role runs
• Outcomes over output. The roadmap is measured by activation, retention, and revenue, not by how many features we ship.
• Data drives priorities. We decide what to build based on usage data: funnels, session recordings, and where users drop off.
• AI where it matters. We apply AI to workflows with heavy manual effort, and keep simple flows simple.
• Build once, serve many. When a client asks for something, your job is to turn it into a capability that other clients can use too.
Key Responsibilities
1. Roadmap and Backlog
• Own the roadmap across activation, engagement, retention, and monetization
• Own and prioritize the product backlog by value, data, and business impact
• Set the success metric for every initiative before work begins
2. Client Requirements and Platform Decisions
• Serve multiple enterprise clients with different ways of working on one platform, without splitting the product into separate versions
• Turn repeated requests into configuration. Build the flexibility before the third client asks for it
• Propose what becomes a platform capability, what becomes configuration, and what gets declined
• Keep client commitments and roadmap work both on schedule
3. Trade Marketing and Brand Programs
• Own the part of the product that lets Trade Marketing and Marketing run programs directly with retailers: loyalty mechanics, promotion execution, sell-out campaigns, brand activation at outlet level
• Give brand managers a clear view of program performance, including whether retailer behavior changed
• Work with Sales and Professional Services (PS) to find where programs break in the field, and fix the cause in the product
4. Data, Behavior and AI
• Own the product analytics: funnels, cohorts, activation events, drop-off points, and add the events we are missing
• Run experiments, watch session recordings, talk to users in the field, and write down what you learned
• Find the repetitive, low-value steps done by retailers, sales reps, and brand teams, and propose AI-assisted alternatives
5. Working with the Teams
• Spend around 30% of your time with clients: meetings, workshops, and field visits, including travel outside HCMC
• Set expectations with clients, Sales, Trade Marketing, and management on what ships, when, and what does not
• With Project Managers: the PM decides project scope and timeline, you decide the product. Raise conflicts early
• With R&D (BA and development team): own requirements, priorities, and acceptance. Drive Agile delivery by running the sprint and ceremonies yourself

If you have a good artistic eye, a love for learning, and a foundational knowledge of Photoshop, we want to help you grow into a key member of our creative team.

• Assist in Asset Creation: Support the art team by using AI tools to generate initial concepts for characters, environments, and props based on guidance from senior artists.
